risk_flags: SCHEMA_DRIFT: Interface declares [id, username, email, createdAt] — 'preferredLanguage' is missing despite active production use by userRouter.ts.
NO_DEFAULT: PRD mandates default 'en-US' but no code-level default is declared on the interface.
SHARED_MODEL: 2 active consumers; any field addition ripples to both without compile-time guards.
UNTYPED: Uses 'as UserProfile' cast on line 57 — defeats TypeScript exhaustive field checking.
FIELD_AHEAD_OF_INTERFACE: Reads/writes user.preferredLanguage on lines 25, 42, 43, 48 but the field is not in the declared interface.
SILENT_UPDATE_GAP: PATCH handler will silently ignore any new optional field added to UserProfile — no compile-time signal that update logic needs extending.
UNSAFE_CAST: req.body cast as 'Partial<UserProfile> & { id: string }' allows objects with missing required fields to be stored silently.
UNTYPED: Accepts Record<string,any> — zero compile-time binding to UserProfile.
DYNAMIC_ITERATION: formatAnalyticsPayload uses Object.entries — every new field on UserProfile is silently consumed with no allowlist.
RUNTIME_CRASH: Calls .toString().toLowerCase() unconditionally on every value — undefined (from a new optional field) will throw 'Cannot read properties of undefined' at runtime.
TELEMETRY_LEAK: dispatchEvent passes the raw user object with no field allowlist — new optional fields automatically leak into the telemetry payload.
NULL_GUARD_MISSING: No guard against null or undefined values for any field.
FIXTURE_DRIFT: Contains only [id, username, email, createdAt] — does not include 'preferredLanguage' despite its active use in userRouter.ts.
NO_SCHEMA_VALIDATOR: No ajv/zod/yup/joi library installed — fixture staleness cannot be automatically detected.
STALE_RISK: Adding any new optional field to UserProfile will not cause any test to fail due to the omission.
NO_COVERAGE_NEW_FIELD: Neither test references, asserts on, or reads any field beyond 'id', 'username', and no-throw behavior.
FALSE_VALIDATION: 'should validate the mock fixture' only checks 'id' and 'username' with an 'in' operator — this is not schema validation and cannot detect fixture staleness.
INCIDENTAL_CATCH_ONLY: Runtime crash from undefined.toString() in eventTracker.ts would cause a test to throw, but only incidentally — there is no assertion designed to catch it.

migration_payload.description: Zero-downtime ADD COLUMN with a server-level DEFAULT. No existing rows are rewritten; the column is backfilled by the DB engine at read time. The contract phase (removing the DEFAULT and enforcing NOT NULL) must be deferred to a separate ticket after all application code has shipped and any legacy row scan has been completed.
sql: -- Safe on Postgres 11+ and MySQL 8.0+ with INSTANT algorithm.
-- Do NOT run the contract phase (DROP DEFAULT / NOT NULL) in this branch.
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS preferred_language VARCHAR(10)
rollback_sql: -- Rollback: drop column if expand phase needs to be reverted
safety_notes: ADD COLUMN … DEFAULT is metadata-only on Postgres 11+ (no table rewrite).
The IF NOT EXISTS guard makes the migration idempotent — safe to replay.
NOT NULL with a DEFAULT is safe here because no existing row can produce NULL after backfill.
Do not add a UNIQUE or CHECK constraint in this phase — those require a full table scan.
Contract phase (enforcing NOT NULL without DEFAULT after backfill verification) is a separate, future ticket.

downstream_guards.rationale: formatAnalyticsPayload calls .toString().toLowerCase() unconditionally on every value via Object.entries. A new optional field (preferredLanguage?: string) will be undefined when absent — undefined.toString() throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined'. The guard must intercept null and undefined before the .toString() call. The fix is strictly additive: no existing behavior changes for defined values.

patch.description: Replace the unconditional value.toString().toLowerCase() call with a null-safe coercion. Values that are null or undefined are normalized to the empty string rather than crashing.
